description: Retire the project's mail domain while the project stays active; use its Prod environment ID. Sending and receiving stop at once, then its provider domain and key are removed. DNS is not changed: remove the returned dns_records from the domain's DNS. Only when the customer no longer wants mail or wants a different mail domain. Requires explicit confirmation; repeat the same key after uncertainty.

profile_name.description: Saved login to act as (profile_list shows them). Needed only when several logins could run this call; OHMYHOST_PROFILE of this server must match it.

name: mail_domain_delete
